---
title: "02 - Smoking response computed within each cohort"
author: "Shuai Guo"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

The change from never to ever smoking, computed **strictly inside each cohort**.
No cross-cohort contrast enters any estimate, so a technical difference between
cohorts cannot generate the pattern (R1-1, R2-6).

Four cohorts carry enough tumours in both smoking strata: Chen2020, Xu2020,
TCGA2014 and TRACERx2023. Chen2019 has no full exome mutation table and no
signature refit; Guo2026 has eight ever-smokers. Both stay in the pooled
analyses (01_four_groups and 03_pooled_vs_stratified) and are excluded here,
which is stated rather than silent.

Every layer that 01_four_groups analyses is analysed here as well: burden, all
active signatures, the six substitution classes, and every gene tested
genome-wide. The within-cohort forest plot is the left half of Figure 1D.

```{r setup}
  knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(patchwork)
  source("_functions.R")

  dir.create("../results/02_within_cohort/tables", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  dir.create("../results/02_within_cohort/figures", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  dir.create("../results/figure1_panels", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  n_boot = 2000
  set.seed(20260809)

  meta = load_metadata(drop_ancestry = TRUE, drop_hyper = FALSE)
  meta = meta[meta$Cohort %in% PER_COHORT_SET, ]
  cohorts = PER_COHORT_SET
  cohort_group = c(Chen2020 = "EAS", Xu2020 = "EAS",
                   TCGA2014 = "Western", TRACERx2023 = "Western")

  sig_wide = load_signature_relative()
  sig_meta = merge(meta, sig_wide, by = "SampleID")
  sig_list = active_signatures(sig_wide)
  point_class = load_point_mutation_classes()
  point_meta = merge(meta, point_class, by = "SampleID")
  classes = c("C>A", "C>G", "C>T", "T>A", "T>C", "T>G")
  table(meta$Cohort, meta$Smoking)
```

# 1. Burden, signatures and substitution classes

```{r within-cohort-scan}
  within = NULL
  for (i in seq_along(cohorts)) {
    co = cohorts[i]
    d = meta[meta$Cohort == co & meta$HasTMB, ]
    r = within_cohort_delta(d$NonsynonymousPerMb, d$Smoking, "TMB", n_boot)
    if (!is.null(r)) {
      r$cohort = co
      r$cohort_group = cohort_group[co]
      r$layer = "TMB"
      within = rbind(within, r)
    }
    ds = sig_meta[sig_meta$Cohort == co, ]
    for (j in seq_along(sig_list)) {
      r = within_cohort_delta(ds[[sig_list[j]]], ds$Smoking, sig_list[j], n_boot)
      if (!is.null(r)) {
        r$cohort = co
        r$cohort_group = cohort_group[co]
        r$layer = "signature"
        within = rbind(within, r)
      }
    }
    dp = point_meta[point_meta$Cohort == co, ]
    for (j in seq_along(classes)) {
      r = within_cohort_delta(dp[[classes[j]]], dp$Smoking, classes[j], n_boot)
      if (!is.null(r)) {
        r$cohort = co
        r$cohort_group = cohort_group[co]
        r$layer = "substitution class"
        within = rbind(within, r)
      }
    }
  }
  within$p_adjusted = p.adjust(within$p_bootstrap, method = "BH")
  write.csv(within, "../results/02_within_cohort/tables/01_within_cohort_all_layers.csv",
            row.names = FALSE)
  cat("estimates:", nrow(within), " significant:",
      sum(within$p_adjusted < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  within[within$feature %in% c("TMB", "SBS4", "SBS1", "C>A"),
         c("cohort", "cohort_group", "feature", "n_never", "n_ever",
           "median_never", "median_ever", "delta", "p_adjusted")]
```

```{r within-cohort-forest}
  show = within[within$feature %in% c("TMB", "SBS4", "SBS1", "C>A", "SBS13"), ]
  show$feature = factor(show$feature, levels = c("TMB", "SBS4", "C>A", "SBS1", "SBS13"))
  show$cohort = factor(show$cohort, levels = cohorts)
  p = forest_plot(show, "delta", "ci_low", "ci_high", "cohort", "cohort_group",
                  GROUP_COLS, "change from never to ever smoking (median, 95% CI)",
                  "Smoking response computed strictly within each cohort")
  p = p + facet_wrap(~ feature, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1)
  p = p + scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(cohorts))
  ggsave("../results/figure1_panels/fig1d_left_within_cohort.pdf", p,
         width = 9.5, height = 3, device = cairo_pdf)
  p
```

```{r within-cohort-heatmap}
  hm = within[within$layer == "signature", ]
  keep = c()
  for (i in seq_along(sig_list)) {
    d = hm[hm$feature == sig_list[i], ]
    if (nrow(d) > 0 && any(d$p_adjusted < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      keep = c(keep, sig_list[i])
    }
  }
  hm = hm[hm$feature %in% keep, ]
  hm$cohort = factor(hm$cohort, levels = cohorts)
  p_hm = ggplot(hm, aes(x = cohort, y = feature, fill = delta))
  p_hm = p_hm + geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4)
  p_hm = p_hm + scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#3B6FB6", mid = "white",
                                     high = "#C0392B", midpoint = 0,
                                     name = "delta")
  p_hm = p_hm + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
                     title = "Signatures with a significant smoking response in any cohort")
  p_hm = p_hm + theme_pub()
  p_hm = p_hm + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
  ggsave("../results/02_within_cohort/figures/signature_heatmap.pdf", p_hm,
         width = 4.5, height = 5.5, device = cairo_pdf)
  p_hm
```

```{r sbs4-distribution}
  d = sig_meta

  p_box = p_box + theme(legend.position = "top")
  ggsave("../results/02_within_cohort/figures/sbs4_by_cohort.pdf", p_box,
```

```{r sbs4-high-fraction}
  high = NULL
  for (i in seq_along(cohorts)) {
    for (sm in c("Never", "Ever")) {
      d = sig_meta[sig_meta$Cohort == cohorts[i] & sig_meta$Smoking == sm, ]
      if (nrow(d) < 3) {
        next
      }
      high = rbind(high, data.frame(cohort = cohorts[i],
                                    cohort_group = cohort_group[cohorts[i]],
                                    smoking = sm, n = nrow(d),
                                    pct_sbs4_above_10 =
                                      round(100 * mean(d$SBS4 >= 0.10, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
                                    median_sbs4 = round(median(d$SBS4, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
                                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    }
  }
  write.csv(high, "../results/02_within_cohort/tables/02_sbs4_high_fraction.csv",
            row.names = FALSE)
  high
```

# 2. Driver genes within each cohort

```{r within-cohort-drivers}
  driver_meta = meta[meta$HasFullMAF, ]
  snv_pa = load_protein_altering(cohorts)
  gene_tab = table(snv_pa$Gene[snv_pa$SampleID %in% driver_meta$SampleID])
  test_genes = names(gene_tab)[gene_tab >= MIN_GENE_MUTATED]
  cat("genes tested:", length(test_genes), "\n")

  drv = NULL
  for (i in seq_along(cohorts)) {
    d = driver_meta[driver_meta$Cohort == cohorts[i], ]
    nv = d$Smoking == "Never"
    ev = d$Smoking == "Ever"
    if (sum(nv) < 5 || sum(ev) < 5) {
      next
    }
    for (j in seq_along(test_genes)) {
      hit = d$SampleID %in% snv_pa$SampleID[snv_pa$Gene == test_genes[j]]
      a = hit[nv]
      b = hit[ev]
      tab = matrix(c(sum(a), length(a) - sum(a), sum(b), length(b) - sum(b)), nrow = 2)
      odds = ((sum(b) + 0.5) * (length(a) - sum(a) + 0.5))
      odds = odds / ((length(b) - sum(b) + 0.5) * (sum(a) + 0.5))
      drv = rbind(drv, data.frame(cohort = cohorts[i],
                                  cohort_group = cohort_group[cohorts[i]],
                                  feature = test_genes[j],
                                  n_never = length(a), freq_never = mean(a),
                                  n_ever = length(b), freq_ever = mean(b),
                                  log2_odds_ratio = log2(odds),
                                  p_value = fisher.test(tab)$p.value,
                                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    }
  }
  drv$p_adjusted = NA
  for (i in seq_along(cohorts)) {
    rows = drv$cohort == cohorts[i]
    if (sum(rows) > 0) {
      drv$p_adjusted[rows] = p.adjust(drv$p_value[rows], method = "BH")
    }
  }
  write.csv(drv, "../results/02_within_cohort/tables/03_driver_within_cohort.csv",
            row.names = FALSE)

  tally = NULL
  for (i in seq_along(cohorts)) {
    d = drv[drv$cohort == cohorts[i], ]
    if (nrow(d) == 0) {
      next
    }
    tally = rbind(tally, data.frame(cohort = cohorts[i], n_tested = nrow(d),
      n_significant = sum(d$p_adjusted < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      up_in_ever = sum(d$p_adjusted < 0.05 & d$log2_odds_ratio > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      up_in_never = sum(d$p_adjusted < 0.05 & d$log2_odds_ratio < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }
  tally
```

```{r driver-slope}
  show_genes = intersect(LABEL_GENES, unique(drv$feature))
  d = drv[drv$feature %in% show_genes, ]
  long = rbind(
    data.frame(cohort = d$cohort, cohort_group = d$cohort_group, gene = d$feature,
               smoking = "Never", freq = d$freq_never, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
    data.frame(cohort = d$cohort, cohort_group = d$cohort_group, gene = d$feature,
               smoking = "Ever", freq = d$freq_ever, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  long$smoking = factor(long$smoking, levels = c("Never", "Ever"))
  p_slope = ggplot(long, aes(x = smoking, y = freq * 100, group = cohort,
                             colour = cohort_group))
  p_slope = p_slope + geom_line(linewidth = 0.5)
  p_slope = p_slope + geom_point(size = 1.6)
  p_slope = p_slope + facet_wrap(~ gene, scales = "free_y")
  p_slope = p_slope + scale_colour_manual(values = GROUP_COLS, name = NULL)
  p_slope = p_slope + labs(x = NULL, y = "mutated tumours (%)",
                           title = "Driver frequency from never to ever smoking, one line per cohort")
  p_slope = p_slope + theme_pub()
  p_slope = p_slope + theme(legend.position = "top")
  ggsave("../results/02_within_cohort/figures/driver_slope.pdf", p_slope,
         width = 8, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
  p_slope
```

# 3. Layers not estimable here

Copy number cannot be stratified by smoking: two of the six cohorts supply
aggregate frequency tables with no sample-level calls. Copy number and fusions
are not analysed in this release, because neither the copy number
quantifications nor the fusion calls are comparable across cohorts.

```{r session}
  sessionInfo()
```
